content.title: Final Four: Illiniois fan Bill Murray switches allegiance to UConn

(Jim Prisching/Chicago Tribune) By Andrew Carter | acarter@chicagotribune.com | Chicago TribunePUBLISHED: April 4, 2026 at 5:00 AM CDT Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...INDIANAPOLIS — The last time Illinois reached the Final Four, in 2005, the Illini’s best-known fan showed up to the national semifinals looking dapper. Bill Murray, an ardent Chicago and Illinois sports enthusiast, longtime bon vivant, a man of many talents and many roles, had that going for him. Which was nice.
